title: Kaboom windows
description: /kaboom saves the server and turns ur Windows pc off :3
body:
# 💣 Kaboom

Kaboom is a powerful yet simple Minecraft plugin where one command ends it all — safely.
Run `/kaboom` and your server will cleanly save the world, stop all processes, and shut down your PC.
It’s the ultimate “I’m done for today” button for server admins and creators.

Whether you’re closing up after a long build session or just want a dramatic exit — Kaboom makes it effortless.

## ⚙️ Features

💾 Safe Shutdown – Saves all worlds and stops the server properly before powering off

💻 System Power Off – Fully shuts down your Windows PC after the server stops

🔒 Operator Only – Accessible only by OPs or users with the `kaboom.use` permission

💬 Custom Command – Type `/kaboom` to activate the sequence

⚡ Lightweight – No configuration, no dependencies, zero setup required

🪄 Perfect for Automation – Great for maintenance scripts, test servers, or personal setups

## 💬 Commands

```
/kaboom
```

Safely saves the world, stops the server, and shuts down the PC.
Permission: `kaboom.use` (default: OP)

## 💡 Use Cases

Run after backup scripts to automatically power down your machine

Include in test or development servers for quick clean shutdowns

Add to LAN setups for easy exit after gameplay

Or just use `/kaboom` for a dramatic, cinematic exit

## 📦 Installation

Kaboom requires Paper or any Paper-compatible Minecraft server (`1.21+`).

To install:

Download the latest `.jar` from Modrinth

Drop it into your server’s `plugins` folder

Start the server

Type `/kaboom` (as OP) — and boom, done ✅

## 🛠️ Requirements

Minecraft: `1.21+`

Server Type: `Paper / Purpur / compatible`

Java: `17+`

OS: `Windows 10 or 11 (for shutdown support)`
